sermon.title: Why Live Life in the Spirit? 10/28/2018
sermon.speaker: Guest speaker (unnamed)
sermon.summary: On family Sunday, a guest speaker shares his testimony of a father who left, an abusive stepfather and years of wrong living, then walks through Romans 8: there is no condemnation in Christ, the Spirit-controlled mind leads to life and peace, and believers are adopted as God’s children and co-heirs with Christ.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Personal testimony mentions physical and verbal abuse by a stepfather (6:30–9:10).

chunks.section_question: Can the sinful nature please God?
chunks.short_answer: The sinful nature is always hostile to God and never will obey His law, so those under its control can never please God; but you are controlled by the Spirit if the Spirit of God lives in you.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God; for it is not subject to the law of God, nor indeed can be. So then, those who are in the flesh cannot please God. But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God dwells in you. Now if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he is not His.

chunks.section_question: Do believers have to obey their sinful nature?
chunks.short_answer: No. You have no obligation to it; if you live through the power of the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the sinful nature and you will live.

faqs.question: How old was he when his father left?
What does he say about living with a girlfriend?
faqs.answer: It is common today but not God’s plan; God wants you married.

faqs.question: Does your past disqualify you?
faqs.answer: No; there is now no condemnation in Christ.

faqs.question: Which commandments are mentioned?
faqs.answer: Do not kill, steal, commit adultery or bear false witness.

faqs.question: What spirit has God not given us?
What are the three reasons given?
faqs.answer: Freedom in Christ, life and peace, and sharing God’s glory as co-heirs.
